facts.value: Undergraduate degree-seeking students who previously attended ASU but have not been enrolled for up to seven consecutive fall or spring semesters may be eligible to return through Quick Re-entry.
Students do not need to submit a new application or application fee and may sign in to My ASU to register for classes.
Students may have a hold or Priority Task that they need to complete before being able to register for classes.
The catalog year upon re-entry will be determined via current policy.
International students are responsible for all SEVIS requirements and should check with the International Students and Scholars Center at ASU.
If the absence is due to military deployment, service on an official church mission, or with a foreign aid service of the federal government, a Leave of Absence should be submitted.
Students must submit official transcript(s) from all institutions attended during their absence from ASU, which must be mailed or sent electronically directly to Admission Services.
Official transcripts must be mailed or sent electronically by the records office of the issuing institutions. ASU does not accept transcripts sent or carried by hand or transmitted by fax.
International students (F1/J1 visa) eligible for quick re-entry should contact ASU's International Students and Scholars Center to submit documentation for issuance of an I-20 for visa purposes.
Students who have completed an ASU bachelor's degree and are seeking to pursue another program or were academically disqualified are not eligible for quick re-entry.
